blocks.text: Agricultural productivity depends on **irrigation and modern inputs** — **HYV seeds, fertilizers, pesticides, credit and mechanisation** — that powered the **Green Revolution**. India has diverse irrigation sources but faces **water stress and over-reliance on groundwater**.

rows: **Wells & tube-wells (largest, ~groundwater), canals, tanks**; net irrigated area rising.
**HYV seeds, chemical fertilizers, pesticides, assured irrigation, mechanisation**.
**Groundwater depletion, waterlogging/salinity, soil degradation, input subsidy burden**.
**PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY), Soil Health Card, Neem-coated urea**.

items: Wells/tube-wells = largest irrigation source (groundwater); Green Revolution inputs = HYV+fertilizer+irrigation.
Micro-irrigation (drip/sprinkler) via PMKSY 'Per Drop More Crop'.

prelimsPointers: **Wells & tube-wells** are India's **largest source of irrigation** (groundwater-based).
**Green Revolution** inputs — **HYV seeds, chemical fertilizers, pesticides, assured irrigation, mechanisation**.
**M.S. Swaminathan** — 'Father of the Indian Green Revolution'; **Norman Borlaug** (global).
**Micro-irrigation** — drip & sprinkler ('Per Drop More Crop').
**PM Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)** — irrigation umbrella scheme.
**Soil Health Card** scheme promotes balanced fertilizer use.
Concerns — **groundwater depletion, waterlogging, salinity, fertilizer subsidy burden**.
mainsAngles: Discuss the role of irrigation and inputs in Indian agriculture.

glossary.definition: The late-1960s leap in food-grain output via HYV seeds, fertilizers and irrigation.
High-Yielding Variety seeds central to the Green Revolution.
The Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana, India's umbrella irrigation programme.

blocks.text: India's **agricultural strategy** evolved from the **Green Revolution's productivity focus to diversification, allied activities and doubling farmers' income**. Yet an **agrarian crisis** — low incomes, indebtedness, price volatility and farmer distress — persists, driving policy reform.

rows: **Green Revolution → diversification (horticulture, dairy, fisheries) → income focus (doubling farmers' income by 2022 target)**.
**Green (foodgrains), White/Operation Flood (milk — Kurien), Blue (fish), Yellow (oilseeds), others**.
**Low & volatile incomes, indebtedness, fragmented holdings, farmer suicides, climate risk**.

items: Agrarian crisis drivers; Swaminathan Commission MSP = C2 + 50%.

prelimsPointers: **White Revolution / Operation Flood** — milk (**Verghese Kurien**, Amul/NDDB).
**Blue (fish), Yellow (oilseeds), Golden (horticulture/honey), Silver (eggs/poultry)** revolutions.
**M.S. Swaminathan Commission (NCF)** — recommended **MSP = C2 cost + 50%**.
Agrarian distress — **indebtedness, fragmented holdings, price volatility, farmer suicides**.
**e-NAM** — electronic National Agriculture Market (unified mandi platform).
**FPOs (Farmer Producer Organisations)** aggregate small farmers.
Goal of **doubling farmers' income** (Dalwai Committee).
mainsAngles: Examine the causes of the agrarian crisis and policy responses.

glossary.definition: Operation Flood — India's dairy revolution led by Verghese Kurien.
The National Commission on Farmers that recommended MSP at C2 cost plus 50%.
The electronic National Agriculture Market linking mandis into one online platform.

blocks.text: **Land reforms** (abolition of intermediaries, tenancy reform, ceilings, consolidation), **institutional agricultural credit**, and **Minimum Support Price (MSP)** are the three pillars of India's effort to make farming equitable and remunerative.

rows: **Abolition of zamindari/intermediaries, tenancy reform, land ceilings, consolidation of holdings, cooperative farming**.
**Cooperatives, RRBs, commercial banks, NABARD (apex), Kisan Credit Card**; priority-sector lending.
Price floor announced by govt (on **CACP** advice) for ~**23 crops**; procurement by FCI.

items: Land reform components (intermediary abolition, tenancy, ceiling, consolidation).
MSP recommended by CACP for ~23 crops; NABARD = apex agri-credit; KCC.

prelimsPointers: Land-reform measures — **abolition of intermediaries (zamindari), tenancy reform, land ceilings, consolidation of holdings**.
**MSP** is recommended by the **Commission for Agricultural Costs & Prices (CACP)** for ~**23 crops**.
**FCI (Food Corporation of India)** procures and maintains **buffer stocks**.
**NABARD (1982)** — apex institution for agricultural & rural credit.
**Kisan Credit Card (KCC)** provides timely crop credit.
**Priority Sector Lending** requires banks to lend to agriculture.
**Bhoodan/Gramdan (Vinoba Bhave)** were voluntary land-reform movements.
mainsAngles: Assess land reforms and the role of MSP in Indian agriculture.

glossary.definition: Minimum Support Price — a government-guaranteed price floor for select crops.
The National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development, apex agri-credit institution (1982).
The Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices that recommends MSPs.

blocks.text: Despite food-grain self-sufficiency, India faces **persistent malnutrition** (stunting, wasting, anaemia). **Food security** — ensured through the **National Food Security Act (2013), PDS and nutrition schemes** — remains a central welfare goal.

rows: Legal right to subsidised foodgrains to **~two-thirds of the population** (75% rural, 50% urban).
Public Distribution System; **One Nation One Ration Card** for portability.
**POSHAN Abhiyaan, ICDS/Anganwadi, Mid-Day Meal (PM POSHAN), fortification**.

items: NFSA 2013 = legal food-grain right to ~2/3 population; ONORC portability.
Malnutrition = stunting/wasting/anaemia; POSHAN Abhiyaan; NFHS data.

prelimsPointers: **National Food Security Act (2013)** covers **~67%** of the population (75% rural, 50% urban).
**PDS/TPDS** delivers subsidised grain; **One Nation One Ration Card (ONORC)** enables portability.
Malnutrition forms — **stunting (chronic), wasting (acute), underweight, anaemia, hidden hunger**.
**POSHAN Abhiyaan** — flagship nutrition mission; **ICDS/Anganwadi, Mid-Day Meal (PM POSHAN)**.
**NFHS (National Family Health Survey)** provides nutrition/health data.
**Food fortification** (rice, salt, oil) tackles micronutrient deficiency.
**Eat Right India, Poshan Vatika** are supporting initiatives.
mainsAngles: Discuss the challenge of malnutrition and India's food-security framework.

glossary.definition: The National Food Security Act (2013) giving ~two-thirds of Indians a legal right to subsidised grain.
Low height-for-age, indicating chronic malnutrition in children.
One Nation One Ration Card — nationwide portability of PDS food entitlements.
